Thanks for looking into #10573. Your root cause analysis is correct, and the change fixes the cases the issue describes.

We have been investigating the issue since f09563c5c5de98026448823de91b1167e1c54160 in branch [`fix/show-all-fraction-digits-in-ai`](https://github.com/vaadin/flow-components/tree/fix/show-all-fraction-digits-in-ai). On the way we ran into the same problems that this PR has: once the limit is lifted, values such as `434.99999999999994` appear in the grid.

One part of this PR was new to us, and we have adopted it: converting a `Float` through its string form before formatting.

We are closing this PR in favor of the branch. The problem turned out to be more complex than the issue text suggests, and it probably needs more investigation before anything is merged.

The limit of three fraction digits does not only cut real digits. It also hides the binary rounding digits of `float` and `double` values, and they appear once the limit is lifted.

### Values that `main` shows wrong

Both this PR and the branch fix these.

| Value | `main` | This PR | Branch |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BigDecimal` `0.0725` | 0.072 | 0.0725 | 0.0725 |
| double `0.0004` | 0 | 0.0004 | 0.0004 |
| double `2.5E-11` | 0 | 0.000000000025 | 0.000000000025 |
| double `1.2345678900012345` | 1.235 | 1.2345678900012345 | 1.2345678900012345 |
| float `123456.78f` | 123,456.781 | 123,456.78 | 123,456.78 |
| float `1.0E20f` | 100,000,002,004,087,730,000 | 100,000,000,000,000,000,000 | 100,000,000,000,000,000,000 |

### Binary rounding digits that `main` hides today

This PR shows them. The branch removes them.

| Value | `main` | This PR | Branch |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0.1 + 0.2` | 0.3 | 0.30000000000000004 | 0.3 |
| `1.1 - 1.0` | 0.1 | 0.10000000000000009 | 0.1 |
| `4.35 * 100` | 435 | 434.99999999999994 | 435 |
| sum of 10,000 × `0.1` | 1,000 | 1,000.0000000001588 | 1,000 |
| `3 * 1.5e-12` | 0 | 0.000000000004500000000000001 | 0.0000000000045 |
| float sum of 12 × `2.4f` | 28.8 | 28.799997 | 28.8 |

### Still open

Neither this PR nor the branch handles these.

| Value | `main` | This PR | Branch |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0.1 + 0.2 - 0.3` | 0 | 0.00000000000000005551115123125783 | 0.00000000000000005551115123125783 |
| `1000.0725 - 1000` | 0.072 | 0.0724999999999909 | 0.0724999999999909 |
| `(1000.01 - 1000) / 1000 * 100` | 0.001 | 0.0009999999999990906 | 0.0009999999999990906 |
| sum of 6,000 × `0.1`, minus `600` | 0 | 0.00000000006787104211980477 | 0.00000000006787104211980477 |
| float sum of 12 × `123.46f` | 1,481.52 | 1,481.5199 | 1,481.5199 |
| sum of 3 × `19.99f` as a double | 59.97 | 59.96999931335449 | 59.96999931335449 |
